With not much more than a year of the sport behind him and only seven months of proper training, James Fairbourn faced up to the best of British under 20 middle-distance talent on the first leg.

Then behind Warren Lynch and James Fairbourn, Robert Norville DID make the ten this time - as did Matthew Taylor. So, we reached the halfway stage over 400 points adrift of Herne Hill and the league seems pretty much sorted with Dulwich doomed to return to Division Two.
